name: AGRICOR
recent: AGRICOR 近期有多项董事及大股东持股变动的申报，包括独立非执行主席 Wong Pak Yii 在公开市场增持股份，以及大股东 Frazel Group、Datuk Keh Chuan Seng、Datin Cheong Kai Meng 和 Oon Boon Khong 的权益变动。公司也发布了截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩报告。
notable: 独立非执行主席 Wong Pak Yii 于 2025 年 9 月 22 日至 29 日期间在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
大股东 Frazel Group、Datuk Keh Chuan Seng、Datin Cheong Kai Meng 及 Oon Boon Khong 于 2025 年 9 月至 11 月期间申报权益变动。
公司发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的业绩报告。

recent_en: AGRICOR recently saw several filings on changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including open-market acquisitions by Independent Non-Executive Chairman Wong Pak Yii, and interest changes by substantial shareholders Frazel Group, Datuk Keh Chuan Seng, Datin Cheong Kai Meng and Oon Boon Khong. The company also released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
notable_en: Independent Non-Executive Chairman Wong Pak Yii acquired shares in the company on multiple occasions in the open market between 22 and 29 September 2025.
Substantial shareholders Frazel Group, Datuk Keh Chuan Seng, Datin Cheong Kai Meng and Oon Boon Khong reported changes in their interests between September and November 2025.
The company released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026.
